_provenance: static_cylinder demo scenario (docs/dev_guide_paper_core_and_dashboard_plan.md §8): pairs with `--scene dynamic_stick --stick none --scene-manifest <this file>` -- same contact-sensor-and-camera-wired scene the swinging stick uses, but with a STATIC obstacle instead, to test reactive.py's live ESDF avoidance against something that doesn't move. Placed at the swinging stick's own centerline (STICK_CENTER_X=0.30, y=0.0 -- the middle of the stick's +-0.22m sweep in sim/scripts/run_robot129_ros_webrtc.py) so it blocks the same central corridor the stick would, for a fair comparison between the two scenarios. Deliberately NOT added to any planner's known geometry (plan_grasp.py / reactive.py's cuboid list) -- same rule the stick follows -- only visible via live depth. Radius/height/xy are authored for the demo, not measured; verify camera visibility with a real render before relying on this exact placement (see the dev guide's §5.3.1 for how to iterate on a manifest).
